text: dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon 是 DSH Web 侧栏会话模型标识插件。它在会话标题旁插入独立品牌图标：当前打开的会话优先跟随模型选择器，其他会话读取最近请求的 provider 和 model 投影。它识别多种模型与服务品牌，并在可区分时组合显示服务和模型标识。适合希望从侧栏快速辨认各会话模型来源的用户。无需额外配置或外部服务。

Adds provider and model brand badges beside sessions in the DSH Web sidebar. The open session follows the live selector; other rows use the last-request projection. Distinct recognized brands can appear together. No extra setup or external service is required.
想在 DSH 侧栏直接看出每个会话用的模型服务。
能否给会话列表加上 provider 品牌标识？
我想区分不同模型路由对应的聊天会话。
让 DSH Web 侧栏显示当前会话选择的模型图标。
切换会话后，怎样确认每条会话最近使用了哪个模型？
Show provider and model logos next to sessions in the DSH sidebar.
Help me identify which model route each chat session last used.
Display the selected model brand for the currently open session.
dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon 的功能Open-session live badge：「打开会话的实时模型标记」：打开的会话读取模型选择器的 per-session 状态，并随选择变化更新侧栏标记。
dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon 的功能Session history fallback：「其他会话的模型标记」：读取会话的 provider 投影，为未打开的会话显示最近一次请求使用的服务和模型。
dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon 的功能Brand badge：「服务与模型品牌图标」：按 provider 和 model 名称识别已知品牌；可识别且不同的品牌会组合显示在同一标记中。
dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon 的功能Sidebar row badge：「侧栏会话行标记」：观察会话列表变化，将独立 badge 放在会话标题前；无法可靠定位的行不显示标记。

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon：*Synthetic English sidebar illustration, light theme on the left and dark theme on the right with the same rows: single vendor marks for Claude, GPT, Grok and Gemini, an aggregator route mark for OpenCode with the GLM vendor corner, and the composite badge for Magpie behind a gateway — Trae in the bottom-left transit corner, DeepSeek in the bottom-right vendor corner. `currentColor` marks follow the theme while Gemini, GLM and DeepSeek keep their brand color in both. It renders an isolated DSH instance that has no model credentials, so badges and rows come from the plugin's own output rather than a recorded live session.*

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon：<!-- problem -->
In the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar every session row looks alike, so you cannot tell which provider and model a conversation uses without opening it. This plugin shows a provider + model icon in front of each session title, read from the model currently selected in the composer, and updates it the moment you switch. When the provider and the model come from different vendors (for example `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`), the provider logo carries a small model logo in its bottom-right corner.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon：- **Real brand marks, nothing generated.** Logos are pinned, vendored SVGs chosen from the actual provider route and model id; nothing is generated or fetched at runtime.
- **Follows the composer live.** The open session tracks the input-box selection immediately; other rows keep their next selection, and cold history falls back to the last real request.
- **Gateway-aware composite.** Aggregator routes show the route logo with the model vendor in the corner, and gateways such as Magpie can add the transit platform as a third layer — all inside the original 14×14 footprint.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · How it behaves：1. **Live selection (preferred, while verifiable).** The official `dsh-client-ui-model-selection` store, read as `ctx.modelDirectories.directoryFor(sessionId).store.current`. It is the single per-session state shared by the input-box selector and the `/model` command, and it publishes `{ provider, model }` as soon as `session.selectModel` succeeds. The open session, including a blank one that has not sent a message yet, therefore follows the input-box selection. That store belongs to a client Session scope, so every session-list and DOM signal re-resolves it: when the runtime hands out a new store for the same session (leaving the session and coming back is enough) the badge re-subscribes and re-reads it, and it re-reads the snapshot even when the identity did not change. An observation is kept only while its session is the open one; once the view moves on — or the directory cannot be resolved any more — it is dropped, so a value the client can no longer verify never decides a row.
2. **Selected model (durable).** The official `modelSelection` projection's `next`: the selection the session will use for its next request. The
dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · How it behaves：Brand resolution has two independent dimensions: the provider route picks the **main logo**, the model id picks the **corner logo**.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · How it behaves：- **Route first.** `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash` shows OpenCode as the main logo; DeepSeek can only appear in the corner.
- **Behind a gateway, up to three layers.** The primary is the gateway, the bottom-right corner is the model vendor, and the **bottom-left** corner is the transit platform — `dsh-magpie-connect / opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash` expresses Magpie, OpenCode and DeepSeek at once. The transit corner only appears when the upstream segment is a known brand that differs from the vendor, so `claude/*`, `codex/*`, `opencode-go/private-model` and `auto|group|custom` stay at two layers or one.
- **No impersonation.** A model whose vendor cannot be identified gets no corner logo, and never a letter badge in the corner.
- **Size.** The composite keeps the 14×14 footprint of a single logo, so the row layout does not move. Both corner logos are bare 10px glyphs overhanging their corner by 4px, with no plate, ring or padding: at this scale any decoration eats the pixels the glyph needs. The bottom-left glyph sits in the gap between the badge and the official status dot, never covering the `StateDot`.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · How it behaves：| Layer | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Host | `src/provider.ts` registers the `provider` projection (it requires the `sessionProjections` service) and folds `request/header`; it only serves the cold-history fallback |
| Client data | `selection-binding.ts` observes the open session's store of `ctx.modelDirectories` (re-resolved per signal); `provider-map.ts` prefers a verifiable observation, then the official `modelSelection` selection, then the `provider` fallback |
| Client DOM | `row-locator.ts` holds all knowledge of the official row DOM: each row is identified by its official `data-row-key="session:<id>"` (the title reverse lookup remains only as the fallback for a runtime without it), so two sessions sharing a display title never receive each other's badge; a `MutationObserver` maintains a separate badge `<span>` in front of the title |
| Brand art | `src/client/assets/*.svg`, downloaded once and bundled; `logos.ts` resolves the provider brand and the model brand separately and renders the composite when they differ |
dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · How it behaves：The badge content is derived only from `(provider, model)`; `index.ts` rebuilds a badge only when those values or the tooltip change.
dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Configuration：None. The plugin row carries no `config` fields and the package reads no environment variables.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Provider / model → icon：The table lists recognized provider route aliases and model-name examples, not a fixed model catalog. Matching ignores case and strips an npm scope and a leading `dsh-` / `dsh_`. A known provider determines the main icon; a different known model brand determines the corner icon. `—` means that dimension is not recognized for that brand. The exact rules live in [`logos.ts`](src/client/logos.ts).

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Provider / model → icon：| Icon | Brand | Provider routes / aliases | Model names / families | |---|---|---|---| | | DeepSeek | `deepseek`, `deepseek-official` | `deepseek-*` | | | OpenAI | `openai`, `codex` | `gpt-*`, `codex-*` | | | Anthropic | `anthropic`, `claude` | `claude-*`, names containing `anthropic` | | | Grok / xAI | `grok`, `xai` | `grok-*` | | | Kimi / Moonshot | `kimi`, `moonshot` | `kimi-*`, `moonshot-*` | | | GLM / Zhipu | `glm`, `z-ai`, `zai`, `zhipu` | `glm-*` | | | MiniMax | `minimax` | `minimax-*` | | | Pi | `pi`, `pi-ai` | `

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Provider / model → icon：Trae and Magpie routes match exact names / prefixes, never arbitrary substrings. OpenRouter and ByteDance are **model-only** mappings: a provider route named `openrouter` does not by itself select the OpenRouter icon.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Provider / model → icon：Behind a gateway route (Magpie) a model id is `<upstream provider>/<model>`, and the two segments own one corner each: the **bottom-right** corner is the model vendor (the model name after the slash first, falling back to the upstream segment read as a provider route — `opencode-go/private-model` → OpenCode); the **bottom-left** corner is the transit platform (the upstream segment, drawn only when it is a known brand that differs from the bottom-right one — `opencode-go` → OpenCode). Non-brand segments (`auto`, `group`, `custom`) produce no transit corner. With neither recognizable the row shows Magpie alone. Other routes keep reading the whole model id. See `openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-25-sidebar-provider-icon-gateway-transit-tier/design.md` for the geometry and the trade-offs.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Provider / model → icon：The model dimension covers every identifiable model family in the OpenCode Go / Zen catalogs, plus the GPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenRouter and ByteDance Seed families in the current TraeX catalog.

Brand art is pinned and vendored, never hand-drawn and never fetched from a CDN at runtime:

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Provider / model → icon：Per-file source URLs and SHA-256 checksums are listed in [`src/client/assets/README.md`](src/client/assets/README.md). Some color SVGs carry gradient/clip ids; the corner instance suffixes them with `-sub` so copies on the same page never resolve each other's definitions.

To add a brand: put the SVG in `src/client/assets/`, record source, pin, license and SHA-256 in the assets README, then add rules and tests to `providerBrandOf` / `modelBrandOf` in `logos.ts`.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Boundaries & safety：- The official `StateDot` is never replaced, moved or hidden; times, row menus and drag behavior stay official.
- The badge is a standalone `<span>` in front of the title. If the row DOM cannot be located reliably, the plugin silently shows nothing and leaves the page intact.
- No network requests of its own: the logos ship with the bundle and the data comes from DSH's own stores and session log.
- Code is MIT-licensed ([LICENSE](LICENSE)). The brand icons are vendored from MIT-licensed upstreams; their copyright notices, the exact rendering changes, and the trademark position are in [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md). Brand owners retain their trademark rights; the marks only identify the selected provider route and model and imply no endorsement.

dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon README · Development：Under vitest, small SVGs are inlined as data URLs with attribute quotes rewritten to `'`. Any regex that rewrites SVG attributes must accept both `"` and `'`.
